items.title: Hyderabad: Art director Anand Sai’s son arrested in hit-and-run after man dies
items.summary: The Cyberabad police on Tuesday, September 1, arrested Sandeep, son of prominent art director Anand Sai, in connection with a hit-and-run case under the Raidurgam police limits. Anand Sai is reportedly a close associate of Andhra Pradesh Deputy Chief Minister Pawan Kalyan. He is also known for designing the Yadadri Lakshmi Narasimha Swamy Temple and is a member of the Tirumala Tirupati Devasthanams (TTD) Board. According to reports, Sandeep allegedly ran over a man identified as Nandulal near the main road connecting the Outer Ring Road (ORR) and Khajaguda before fleeing the spot. As Nandulal was being rescued by a student, identified as Zaid Shah Qadri, another speeding car allegedly hit him, leaving him seriously injured. Nandulal later died. Police subsequently traced Sandeep using CCTV footage and identified the vehicles involved in the accident. “Sandeep has been detained for questioning; we cannot reveal details of the accident right now,” a police officer was quoted as saying by Siasat. items.title: Chennai: Man arrested for stabbing bedridden father to death
items.summary: Follow TNM’s WhatsApp channel for news updates and story links. A 45-year-old man, Natarajan, has been arrested for stabbing his father, Rajendran, who had been bedridden for a month due to a leg injury. The incident happened on August 30 near Thiru Vi Ka nagar, Chennai. Though Rajendran was rushed to a hospital, he was declared dead. Three days before the incident, Natarajan’s wife, Ezhila Mary, had gone to Velankanni with their two children. Before leaving, she had asked Natarajan to take care of his father. When Ezhila returned home on Sunday morning, she found the house unclean and noticed that Rajendran had soiled the bed as he was unable to move around. She scolded Natarajan for failing to take proper care of his father. Police told TNM that an argument broke out between Natarajan and Rajendran. As the argument escalated, Natarajan allegedly stabbed his father with a knife. The police have registered a case under Section 103(1) — Punishment for Murder — of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), 2023, and arrested Natarajan. This story was written by a student interning with TNM.
